answer: Problem: relic invite trees let one operator mint disposable keys that swamp an oasis of honest matching slots. Mechanism: each claim locks a gale-paced collateral ticket H(pk||epoch||relay_id) and must clear two work digests on separate relays at least thirty-five minutes apart. Cost: a skipped digest burns the ticket and freezes that key from matching for six epochs. Verification: peers recompute the ticket hash against the public relay log and cull same-operator clusters. Failure: reused tickets or forged relay digests zero attestation weight for the claim.
